prompt: In ClangIR's calling-convention lowering, where is an MLIR type converted into the type that the shared ABI classification code works on, what interface does a dialect implement so that functions and call sites get rewritten from a classification, where is CIR's implementation of that interface, and which pass drives it? Name the files and classes, with paths relative to the repository root.
key: From clang/docs/CIR/ABILowering.md (added 2026-03-06, revised in #188617 on 2026-04-08, moved under clang/docs/CIR on 2026-04-14). Classification lives in the LLVM ABI library (llvm/lib/ABI, headers in llvm/include/llvm/ABI) over its abi::Type shadow types. ABITypeMapper (mlir/include/mlir/ABI/ABITypeMapper.h, mlir/lib/ABI/ABITypeMapper.cpp) maps mlir::Type to abi::Type*. ABIRewriteContext (mlir/include/mlir/ABI/ABIRewriteContext.h) is the dialect-specific interface that consumes the classification and rewrites functions and calls. CIR's implementation is CIRABIRewriteContext in clang/lib/CIR/Dialect/Transforms/TargetLowering/CIRABIRewriteContext.h/.cpp. The pass is CallConvLowering (clang/lib/CIR/Dialect/Transforms/CallConvLoweringPass.cpp, declared in clang/include/clang/CIR/Dialect/Passes.td), which builds a CIRABIClassifier (clang/lib/CIR/Dialect/Transforms/CIRABIClassifier.h) and dispatches to CIRABIRewriteContext.

sources.quote: (1) **ABITypeMapper** maps `mlir::Type` to `abi::Type*` (analogous to QualTypeMapper for Clang).
ABIRewriteContext is the only dialect-specific layer: CIR and FIR each
The LLVM ABI library in `llvm/lib/ABI/` performs ABI classification on `abi::Type*`.

rubric.criterion: Names ABITypeMapper (mlir/include/mlir/ABI/ABITypeMapper.h or mlir/lib/ABI/ABITypeMapper.cpp) as the mlir::Type to abi::Type* bridge into the LLVM ABI library (llvm/lib/ABI)
Names the ABIRewriteContext interface (mlir/include/mlir/ABI/ABIRewriteContext.h) and CIR's CIRABIRewriteContext under clang/lib/CIR/Dialect/Transforms/TargetLowering/
Every path and name given exists and does what the answer says
